feature: A title with a fade in and a fade out shows during playback
summary: A title on a full-size Mac screen recording now shows, stopped and playing, fading in and out as its keys say. Before, it never drew at all on a recording that big, fades or not. Trimming a title's bar now also keeps its Animate Out at the new end.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Use one of your own screen recordings (full screen, Retina), or the walk a-faded-title-shows-while-playing-walk, which opens a 3456 x 2234 recording.

try.do: Open a full-screen recording. Put the playhead at one second, press T, click on the picture and type a title, then press Command Return.
Right-click the title on the canvas and choose Animate In > Fade, then right-click again and choose Animate Out > Fade.
Step a quarter second forward: the words are half way up.
Step to the middle of the title: the words are fully up.
Step to just before the title's end: the words are almost gone.
Put the playhead back on the title's in point and press Space: the words fade up, hold, and fade away.
Drag the right end of the title's bar a second later, then play again: the fade out now finishes at the new end.
Export as MP4 at 1080p and scrub the file: the title fades the same way.

evaluate: On your own recording, is the title there the moment you type it, before any fade is added?
Does the fade in and fade out during playback look like the diamonds on the title's row say it should?
After dragging the title's end later or earlier, does its fade out still finish exactly at the end of the bar?
Does the exported file look the same as playback?
rough: The first picture (step 1) is from BEFORE the fix, the same moment as step 4: the outline and handles with no words. That is what you saw.

The fault was not the fades. Since 2026-09-26 the canvas has drawn a big recording at the size the window shows it, to keep scrubbing smooth, and never told the drawing step, so words were set at full size inside a box shrunk to a fraction of that and drew nothing. Samples at 1280 x 800 never shrink, which is why every walk passed. Export was never affected.

The stopped pictures are at 1.25s, the middle and 3.5s rather than a tenth of a second after the in point: the walk steps a quarter second at a time. The playback check logs twenty moments and finds the words in the picture at every one where they are at least half up.
No mock covers this: it is a fault in a surface that already matches the video mock's title, so there is no side-by-side here.
